scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a reasonable job identifying the core issue as a shared output directory conflict causing signing failures. It correctly identified the race condition nature of the problem and provided actionable suggestions. However, it missed the likely deeper cause related to CAS hard links or read-only file attributes in CloudBuild environments, which would better explain the high 84% failure rate. The fix suggestions were directionally correct but lacked specificity about the actual build system mechanisms (Distrib/Robocopy) involved.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects
